structured_prompt:
3D OBJECT RENDER - SINGLE CUBE
One white ceramic cube, 8cm sides, perfect cube with sharp edges and six flat faces. Matte B4C technical ceramic. Isolated 3D object, not pattern.

GEOMETRY
Perfect cube geometry. Six square faces meet at 90-degree angles. Sharp edges visible. Three faces visible from camera angle. Clear 3D form with depth and volume.

OBJECT ISOLATION
Single solid cube object floating or resting on surface. Object casts shadow beneath. Background secondary and dark. Object edges define silhouette clearly.

EDGES
Twelve edges visible as sharp lines. Edge highlights define cube boundaries. No rounded corners. Geometric precision.

MATERIAL
Matte B4C technical ceramic. Warm white #FAFAFA. Flat faces show subtle eggshell texture. Zero gloss. Industrial ceramic, not plastic.

LIGHTING
Directional light from upper left. Three faces at different brightness levels showing 3D form. Clear cast shadow. Dark minimal background.

COMPOSITION
Single cube centered. Full object visible. Edges sharp. No decorative patterns on faces. No abstract elements.

REJECT IF
No cube visible. No sharp edges. Pattern only. Abstract texture. Wall or slab appearance.

COLOR
subtractive mineral color logic
color must follow form then material, never override them
low saturation, no neon
matte-first material response
shadow-dominant composition (70%)
bokashi gradient, non-linear
no flat color, always material texture variation
diffuse highlights, not specular
pure white and pure black are forbidden
plastic-clean RGB color is forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones
shadow_anchor_sumi_iro
highlight_anchor_gofun
crimson_seam_if_applicable
